compatibilities.description: devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern establishes the CANONICAL deployment method (Helm). devbob-k8s-git-operations validates GIT OPERATIONS within deployed pods. Sequential dependency: Deployment → Git Operations.
compatibilities.benefit: Standardizing on Helm deployment (devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern) provides consistent environment for git operations testing (devbob-k8s-git-operations)

compatibilities.description: devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern defines HOW devbob is deployed. devbob-acp-multi-vessel-coordination defines WHAT functionality devbob provides (ACP delegation). Both require container image rebuild and redeployment.

compatibilities.description: devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern defines LOCAL deployment pattern. Helmfile pattern extends this to MULTI-ENVIRONMENT (local, staging, production) with Istio support.
compatibilities.benefit: Local deployment pattern (port 8080, --print-logs) provides solid foundation. Helmfile pattern adds environment-specific overrides and Istio integration for production

compatibilities.description: devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern operates at APPLICATION layer (devbob deployment). Deployment-Validation-Exit-Codes operates at INFRASTRUCTURE layer (general K8s validation). No overlap.
compatibilities.benefit: Deployment-Validation-Exit-Codes validates that devbob deployment health checks work correctly (validated by devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern test case 1)
